method.estimator: geometric mean + Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance, 252-day annualised
method.expected_returns: momentum: the return over 11 months, ending 1 month(s) before the start date
method.tangency: frontier._solve max_sharpe at the cutoff's ^IRX yield
caveats: the test windows are nested, so the cutoffs are not independent trials
the universe is 116 funds that exist today with quotes back to the start date, so every asset tested survived the period
no transaction costs, no taxes, no slippage

the weights are chosen ONCE per holding period, so a 1,2-year hold tests momentum measured annually -- the effect is documented at monthly refresh and decays over months, so this understates it by an unknown amount
momentum turns the portfolio over far faster than the historical mean does, and 'no transaction costs' above is therefore a larger subsidy here
method.rolling: 5.0y training window walked forward in non-overlapping holding periods over the last 10.0y
